asked.item: What Claude did to remove the photo after a caption edit
How a caption edit should be done

verdict.reason: The MCP edit FAQ explains that leaving out mediaUrls when updating a schedule removes the post's media.

steps.text: To change a caption through MCP, the whole post object has to be passed, not just the field being edited.
Fields left out of a complete post are not kept, and leaving out mediaUrls removes the post's media.
The recommended flow is to use blotatogetschedule to fetch the current full post object, then blotatoupdateschedule with the full post object and your edit applied.
